results.notes: owslib.ogcapi.features.Features constructed against the landing page and returned 7 live links including self/conformance/data.

Transport verified as plain http on the compose client-compat network, which terminates no TLS. TLS handshake behaviour is exercised in the release tier, where the same lane runs against the HTTPS candidate.

Anonymous GET /api/v1/admin/services -> 401 with WWW-Authenticate: ApiKey realm="Honua Admin", header="X-API-Key". Probed with owslib.util.http_get (the transport owslib.ogcapi uses); OWSLib has no client surface for Honua's admin control plane.

Accepted scheme: x-api-key (X-API-Key header carrying HONUA_ADMIN_PASSWORD) -> 200. Scheme ladder tried: x-api-key=200. owslib.util.Authentication covers HTTP Basic/cert only, so the API key travels as a header on OWSLib's own http_get.
Features.collections() listed 5 collections: ['2000', '2001', '2002', '3000', '0'].
Features.collection('0') -> title='Test Layer', itemType='feature', storageCrs='http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326'.
Features.collection_queryables() advertised 13 properties covering all 10 seeded scalar attributes.
All 9 geometry-bearing features report GeoJSON type Point, matching the seeded Point layer; the null-geometry row is preserved as null. Queryables declare geometry property ['shape'].
CQL2-text "status = 'active'" matched 5 of 10 features, and every returned feature carries the filtered value.
bbox=[-122.495, 37.705, -122.455, 37.735] selected 3 features (['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma']); every returned coordinate lies inside the window.
limit=3 returned exactly 3 features while numberMatched stayed at the full 10.
offset=3 returned a disjoint page: ['alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'] then ['delta', 'epsilon', 'zeta'].
Anchor feature 'alpha' returned (-122.49, 37.71) against seeded (-122.49, 37.71); max ordinate deviation 0.0 degrees, threshold 1e-06.

crs=http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326 was echoed verbatim in Content-Crs and the payload switched to the CRS's declared latitude/longitude axis order (37.71, -122.49); the CRS84 default returns longitude first.

OWSLib raised RuntimeError carrying the server's RFC 7807 problem+json body for collection 'does-not-exist-9999': {"type":"about:blank","title":"Not Found","status":404,"detail":"Collection \u0027does-not-exist-9999\u0027 not found.","instance":"/ogc/features/collections/does-not-exist-9999/it

extensions.notes: A syntactically valid but incorrect X-API-Key returns 401, not 403 or 500.

collection.extent.spatial.bbox=[-122.5, 37.7, -122.35, 37.84] encloses the seeded feature envelope [-122.49, 37.71, -122.37, 37.79] and is declared in CRS84; temporal interval ['2024-01-01T12:00:00Z', '2024-01-10T12:00:00Z'] matches the seeded created_at range.
Landing page carries typed self/conformance/data/service-desc links plus an alternate representation, which is what OWSLib navigates from.
Features.api() resolved the service-desc link to an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document describing 15 paths, including the landing page, collections, single collection and collection items resources.
Declared conformance classes were exercised rather than trusted: ['crs', 'queryables', 'cql2-text'] all behaved as advertised.
All 12 seeded attributes round-trip with their JSON types preserved (bool/int/double/array), not stringified.
Queryables is a 2020-12 JSON Schema with $id, every property typed, and the non-queryable JSON array columns correctly excluded.
CQL2-text `count > 7` compares numerically (3 rows: theta/iota/lambda); a lexical comparison would also return rows 8 and 9 or drop 10.
A closed RFC 3339 interval on the seeded created_at column selects exactly the three features inside it (alpha/beta/gamma).
OWSLib's (property, direction) sortby tuple maps to the server's `-name` convention; desc is the exact reverse of asc over all 10 features.
A limit=3 walk over the collection yielded 10 distinct feature ids, exactly matching numberMatched=10: no gaps, no repeats, stable ordering.
Paged responses advertise self+next and no prev on page 1; a response that already covers numberMatched advertises no next link.

Followed the advertised next href verbatim (http://honua:5000/ogc/features/collections/0/items?limit=3&offset=3&f=geojson); it returned a disjoint GeoJSON page, so OWSLib-style link walking works without URL reconstruction.
/items/1 returned the identical Feature the collection listing carried, with self and collection link relations.

CRS84 -> lon/lat, EPSG:4326 -> lat/lon (axis order honoured, not just echoed), EPSG:3857 -> (-13635524.42726808, 4538539.15341347) which is within 3.725290298461914e-09 m of the spherical-Mercator projection of the seeded anchor.

All 3 CRSs advertised on the collection were accepted by /items and echoed back in Content-Crs: ['http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/3857', 'http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326', 'http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84'].
All 5 deliberate client errors (unknown collection, unknown item, bad CRS, negative offset, short bbox) returned RFC 7807 problem+json with matching status, title, detail and instance.
